facts.fact: Presidential decree D/2017/184/PRG/SGG, signed at Conakry on 26 July 2017 and effective from signature, ratifies the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection signed at Malabo on 27 June 2014, following authorising law L/2017/023/AN of 16 June 2017.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)

facts.fact: The African Union Commission status list of 2 February 2026 records Guinea with ratification/accession on 31 July 2018 and deposit on 16 October 2018, and no date of signature, for the Malabo Convention.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

slug: 2026-04-08 Africa's digital trade push requires 700 data centres, says AfCFTA chief
note: Names Guinea only as a new participating country at GITEX Africa; the AfCFTA Digital Trade Protocol is discussed continent-wide with nothing stated about Guinea.

facts.fact: The ministry's secretary-general Nouhan Traore says Guinea signed and ratified the Malabo Convention.
